{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
# Also, check for QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders found:", qa_mask.sum())

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Final population: exclude QA and refunded orders
valid_mask = ~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)
print("Total valid orders:", valid_mask.sum())

# Subset to valid orders
df_valid = df[valid_mask].copy()

# Check cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment again
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df_valid['channel'], df_valid['customer_segment'])
print("\nCross-tabulation after filtering:")
print(cross_tab)

# Compute conversion rates by channel and segment
df_grouped = df_valid.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).round(4)
df_grouped = df_grouped.rename(columns={'mean': 'conversion_rate', 'count': 'n'})
print("\nConversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(df_grouped)

# Compute raw difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
# But note: this is confounded by segment imbalance
email_conv = df_valid[df_valid['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv = df_valid[df_valid['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_diff = email_conv - paid_search_conv
print(f"\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")"}
